messages:
elaine: Quick sync — Sprint 9 private rollout for Cardinal Labs. Customer timeline: target 2026-03-29 for VPC + air-gapped. Need owners for the following blockers. :wave:

mike: Working on onprem-agent packaging. PR open: https://github.com/redwood/onprem-agent/pull/412 — awaiting review. cc @raj for net changes.

raj: Networking: firewall rules and BGP peering scheduled. Ran into DNS split-horizon issue; need confirmation from customer's infra team on internal DNS zones. Pinged them.

sofia: Security/KMS: we need an HSM cert rotation plan. Is Cardinal using customer-managed keys? @natasha do we have onboarding docs for HSM? :thinking: 

natasha: Release ops: yes, CMK enabled. I can lead the key-handoff window. Need a 2-hour maintenance window. Also need to confirm time zone.

elaine: Blocker list — short bullets inline:
- onprem-agent PR review (mike) -> owner: mike, ETA: today
- firewall + peering config (raj) -> owner: raj, ETA: 2026-03-24
- DNS zones confirmation (customer) -> pending
- HSM knowledge transfer + KMS policy (sofia/natasha) -> owner: sofia, ETA: 2026-03-25
- Airgap install image signing + checksum (mike/eng-release) -> owner: mike, ETA: 2026-03-26

raj: Example firewall snippet I'm testing:
```
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
# allow management from bastion
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -s 172.16.5.10 -j ACCEPT
```

mike: Added CI job to publish signed images: `ci/onprem/publish-signed-images` — failing on checksum step, investigating.

elaine: Can reviewers please prioritize: @sofia :eyes: @raj :eyes: @mike :eyes: — small things block cutover. If you're blocked, reply with short status.

deploy-bot: New task created: PRIVATE-7899 'Cardinal private deploy readiness' assigned to elaine, natasha

sofia: I'll review the PR in ~2 hours. On HSM, I need the key policy doc from customer. Dropping a checklist comment.

raj: Customer confirmed DNS zone names. Updated peering template, pushing to staging. ETA 30m.

mike: PR merged. CI green. Signed images now publish to staging registry. :tada:

elaine: Awesome. Updated tracker: owner ETA changed. Next sync async here — post any regressions. Thanks!
